tham_definition_5_11_premodular_handle_m.relevance_to_twisted_yetter: High-priority source for the handle-by-handle extended Crane-Yetter skein map before imposing modular-category signature simplifications. This is directly relevant to future dotted/special-link and 3-handle evaluator design.

handle_maps.map_summary: Adds a new S^3 component and multiplies by D.
After isotoping the graph away from the attaching balls, includes the graph in the new boundary and multiplies by D^{-1}.
Adds a trivially framed core circle in the 2-handle belt solid torus, colored by the regular color.
Projects the graph crossing the 3-handle co-core onto the tensor-unit/simple-object-1 channel, after decomposing crossings into simple-label summands.
Evaluates the graph in the killed S^3 component by Reshetikhin-Turaev evaluation and leaves the remaining graph.

summary.interpretation_for_current_project: For ordinary modular closed-manifold specializations the handle maps can collapse to scalar signature/Euler-characteristic formulae, but the premodular handle-level definition indicates that 3-handles are categorically vacuum-channel projections rather than merely global-dimension scalars. A twisted/H2-marked extension should therefore record the 3-handle relation data and the corresponding unit-channel constraint.
summary.setup: For an elementary index-k cornered handle cobordism W = H_k o id_M, Tham defines a linear map Z_CY^sk(W;N) between skein modules for an arbitrary premodular-category Crane-Yetter setup.
